blockingIssues.description: The round-2 blocker on reviewer-model portability remains unresolved: validation droids still pin `custom:GPT-5.4-mini-[cch]-2`, and no new fix feature in this rerun addresses that portability gap.
blockingIssues.suggestedFix: Add a follow-up fix feature that switches scrutiny/user-testing droids to Task-portable model IDs (or a deterministic fallback chain) and rerun scrutiny afterward.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a mission-level rule that project validation droids must use Task-portable model IDs, and if custom IDs are required, document an explicit fallback strategy.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Round-2 failed this feature for portability, and this round still has no fix that removes the `custom:*` dependency.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add explicit instructions for repo-scoped droid/model override tasks, including how to select portable model IDs and validate launches without relying on personal settings.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The only remaining blocker in ai-search-quality is still model-id portability for validation droids.
